description: Python source code for a PIL-based image loader class used within the Kivy framework, supporting GIF animation and image format conversions.

classes.name: ImageLoaderPIL
classes.description: A class that implements image loading functionality based on the PIL library, supporting GIFs and image format conversions.

methods.name: can_save
methods.description: Determines if an image format can be saved by this loader.

methods.name: can_load_memory
methods.description: Indicates if the loader can load images from memory.

methods.name: extensions
methods.description: Returns supported file extensions for this loader.

methods.name: _img_correct
methods.description: Converts images to RGBA format if necessary.

methods.name: _img_read
methods.description: Reads images from an animated file, yielding ImageData objects.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an image file and returns a list of ImageData objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves image data to a file with specified dimensions and format.
